claims: Carlos Ulberg is the reigning UFC Light Heavyweight Champion.
Carlos Ulberg won the vacant title at UFC 327 on April 11, 2026.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka via first-round knockout at UFC 327.
Carlos Ulberg suffered a knee injury during the fight against Jiří Procházka.
Carlos Ulberg secured the championship with a decisive check left hook.
Carlos Ulberg defeated Jiří Procházka via KO (punch) at 3:45 of Round 1 at UFC 327.
The UFC Light Heavyweight title became vacant after previous champion Alex Pereira vacated the belt.
Alex Pereira vacated the UFC Light Heavyweight title belt to move up to the heavyweight division.
The 205-pound division is currently headed by Carlos Ulberg.
Carlos Ulberg is a New Zealand fighter.
Carlos Ulberg became the first Kiwi to hold the light heavyweight title.
